messages:
maya_procure: Vendor emailed: H100 tranche on PO# 2026-10-12 pushed +14 days. They propose splitting shipment across AMS and FRA (split 50/50) to hedge customs risk.

leo_ops: Splitting fine but we need to protect na-west2 warm-spares. Which AWBs?

maya_procure: Tentative AWBs: AMS 1ZAMS20345, FRA 1ZFRA20346. Vendor also flagged 3 depot DOAs under RMA-44521.

anika_eng: If AMS can cover at least 2 of the loaners we'll be OK. I'll prepare a quick routing tweak: prefer AMS for latency-critical pools, pin FRA to low-priority. Can we get loaners written into the amendment?

rachel_logistics: Carrier bot: FRA AWB 1ZFRA20346 - customs hold pending HS code and commercial invoice. Upload or email customs@carrier.example to start clearance.

carrier_bot: Status: AWB 1ZFRA20346 - hold. Clearance expected 48-72h after docs accepted.

leo_ops: RMA decision: depot repair (~8-12d) vs AMS loaner overnight (~$4.8k). If vendor will commit loaners we should take them.

maya_procure: Asked vendor for loaner commitment + freight credit. Vendor replied they can provide 3 loaners from AMS for 5 days and 30% freight credit on overnight. Drafting PO amendment now.

anika_eng: Great. I'll make the routing PR and add a metric check for p95 tail and KV-cache warmups. Also add a fallback to quantized variants for non-critical routes.

rachel_logistics: Uploaded FRA docs at 2026-10-14T08:21Z. Carrier portal shows "docs accepted".

carrier_bot: Update: AWB 1ZFRA20346 cleared customs at 2026-10-14T12:05Z.

maya_procure: Loaners shipped from AMS (AWB 1ZAMS20347). ETA depot 2026-10-15 morning. Freight credit applied. Closing loop ":thumbsup:"
